alt-point-measurement-estimates-vessel-v: Measuring a capillary's width at one point is enough to track how its volume changes, so full 3D segmentation is unnecessary.
artery-dilates-venule-unchanged-at-low-p: Under weak blue-light stimulation an artery and a capillary dilated while a venule did not change.
baseline-intra-vessel-radius-varies-24pc: A capillary's radius varies substantially along its own length even at rest, so a single-point width cannot stand for its volume.
blue-light-dilations-exceed-green-contro: Capillary dilations after blue light that activates ChR2 are larger than those after green control light.
capillary-efficiency-increases-4pct: Blood-flow efficiency across the capillary network rises slightly at the peak of optogenetic stimulation.
constrictions-deeper-than-dilations: Capillaries that constrict after stimulation sit deeper in cortex than those that dilate, which cluster nearer the surface.
dilations-nearer-neurons-than-constricti: Capillaries that dilate after ChR2 activation lie closer to labelled pyramidal neurons than ones that constrict, with no such split under control light.
dl-model-scope-single-pipeline: Every neurovascular measurement comes from one deep-learning pipeline trained on a single mouse preparation and needing a GPU.
hypothesis-dl-pipeline-enables-network-n: A deep-learning segmentation and graph pipeline can measure neurovascular coupling automatically across hundreds of connected vessels at once.
hypothesis-network-level-nvc-coordinatio: Activating cortical neurons drives a coordinated network-wide vascular response that single-vessel measurements cannot reveal.
network-assortativity-increases-stimulat: During strong optogenetic stimulation highly connected vessels respond together with other highly connected vessels more than at rest.
novas3d-generalizes-qualitatively-ood: The NOVAS3D segmentation model gives plausible vessel outlines on another mouse strain, on rat, and on light-sheet images, without retraining.
novas3d-outperforms-ilastik: NOVAS3D segments vessels in three dimensions more accurately than the ilastik classifier on the deposited two-photon test images.
novas3d-single-preparation-scope: NOVAS3D's accuracy is measured only in Thy1-ChR2-YFP mice under one imaging protocol, and in no other strain, species or modality.
prediction-pipeline-outperforms-baseline: The pipeline should beat ilastik at segmentation, find more vessel segments than any single time point, and recover simulated radii accurately.
prediction-pipeline-reveals-network-coor: Blue-light stimulation should separate dilations from constrictions by distance from neurons and shift network-wide flow measures, unlike control light.
radius-estimation-r2-0p68: The pipeline's radius estimator recovers simulated vessel radii well and stays stable as image noise rises.
registration-doubles-vessel-count: Aligning the volumes across time points and merging their masks nearly doubles the number of vessel segments found per field of view.
responder-threshold-2sd-untested: A vessel counts as responding if its radius change exceeds twice its baseline variability, a threshold varied only in an appendix.
scope-pipeline-and-application-paper: The pipeline is benchmarked and applied in one anaesthetised mouse preparation, with generalisation to others shown only by eye.
synthesis-individual-vessel-measurements: Measuring vessels one at a time cannot predict how blood flow is redistributed across the cortical microvascular network.
unetr-outperforms-ilastik-hd95: The UNETR ensemble traces vessel and neuron surfaces more accurately than ilastik, which over-segments vessels.
vessel-radius-heterogeneity-stimulation: Vessel radius changes during stimulation vary widely, and dilating vessels lie closer to active neurons than constricting ones.
wt-controls-no-blue-green-difference: In wild-type mice without ChR2, blue and green light produce no difference in capillary radius.
